page.title: Review
page.purpose: Show planned versus recorded activity with unrecorded periods explicitly visible, let the user carry work forward deliberately, and surface a small number of inspectable, evidence-linked learning suggestions.

priorities.statement: Unrecorded periods are visible, not hidden; the review never treats missing activity as productive or zero time.
'All tasks completed' is not the definition of a good day; a deliberate scope reduction or early renegotiation is recorded as a useful decision.
Denominators and unknown coverage are shown; with only two tracked days, the week is not described as precisely measured.
Each insight has supporting records, an explanation, and a practical proposed adjustment; accepting it is an explicit, auditable setting change, never a silent rewrite.

states.description: Daily/weekly read models resolve with coverage.
Planned vs actual, coverage, carry-forward choices, and any eligible insights are visible.
No history yet: explain that learning needs records and provide editable manual defaults rather than a suggestion.
Below the evidence threshold: show descriptive history and state why no adjustment is suggested.
Review figures depend on stale inputs (e.g. an unrefreshed integration): coverage and freshness are disclosed rather than presented as precise.
A summary failed to load: retain last-known review with a retry.
